scripts.version:patch: pnpm version patch -m "Upgrade to %s" && git push --follow-tags
scripts.version:minor: pnpm version minor -m "Upgrade to %s" && git push --follow-tags
scripts.version:major: pnpm version major -m "Upgrade to %s" && git push --follow-tags
scripts.version:prepatch: pnpm version prepatch -m "Upgrade to %s" && git push
scripts.version:preminor: pnpm version preminor -m "Upgrade to %s" && git push
scripts.version:premajor: pnpm version premajor -m "Upgrade to %s" && git push
